abstract: The over-all 3,5 and 10-year survival rate for 87 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis undergoing retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy was 90.5 per cent. Of the 72 patients receiving no form of therapy other than retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy after operative removal of the testicular tumor the 5-year survival rate was 90.8 per cent. The 5-year survival rates for these 72 patients, calculated according to the histologic characteristics of the primary tumor, were 74.4 per cent for 18 patients with embryonal carcinoma, 93.0 per cent for 36 patients with teratocarcinoma and 100 per cent for 18 patients with teratoma. Although no advantage could be demonstrated for bilateral lymphadenectomy as opposed to unilateral dissection, it is concluded that a modified bilateral dissection should be reserved only for tumors on the left side.
abstract_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を受けた精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍87例における全体の3年、5年および10年生存率は90.5％であった。精巣摘除術後に郭清のみで治療した72例の5年生存率は、組織学的特徴に応じて算出したところ、胎児性癌18例で74.4％、奇形癌36例で93.0％、奇形腫18例で100％であった。片側郭清に対する両側郭清の利点は示されなかった。修正両側郭清は左側の腫瘍にのみ適用すべきと結論する。
